title: Product Bundle Photos That Show the Full Set | AIVideosUGC
description: Create product bundle photos that show every piece of your set in one styled frame. Upload each item in the kit and make a clear what's-in-the-box image.
h1: Product Bundle Photos with Every Piece in One Frame
lead: Product bundle photos put every bottle, jar, and box from your kit in one square frame, so buyers know exactly what arrives when they order the set.
intro: The example shows a skincare set on a round stone tray: a frosted serum bottle with a dropper, a cream jar with a gold lid, and the leaf-printed carton they come in. A folded towel and a few white blossoms set the mood without hiding any piece.

Bundle listings raise one question above all: what do I actually get? One photo with every item, and nothing extra, answers it at a glance. Add it right after your main image on Amazon or Shopify, and use it for gift sets, starter kits, and refill packs.
tip: Upload every piece that comes in the set, box included, and list them in your description, so the photo shows your kit and no extra products.

steps.d: Photograph each piece, or lay out the full set together, so every item you ship is in your upload.
Write the count and names, such as "one serum bottle, one cream jar, one gift box, on a stone tray," so nothing is added or dropped.
Save the square photo and place it right after your main image, where shoppers look for what the bundle includes.

ideas.d: Style a seasonal trio with ribbon or pine sprigs while every product stays in clear view.
Show the full-size product next to its refill pouch or travel minis so buyers can see which sizes are in the kit.
Coffee with a mug, a phone case with a screen protector, or a candle with matches: any set with a fixed list of pieces fits.

faq.q: Why did an extra item show up in my bundle photo?
faq.a: That usually happens when a piece is missing from your upload or the description leaves room for guessing. Upload every item, state the exact count, and run it again.

faq.q: Can I add the bundle price to the photo?
faq.a: Put the price and any savings line on later, using Canva or a similar app. Text generated inside the image can come out with typos, so the photo is made without it.

faq.q: Can the photo show results like glowing skin?
faq.a: Keep the photo about the products themselves. Showing the set is fine, but results such as clearer or younger-looking skin shouldn't be promised in the image or the listing text.

faq.q: How do I keep a bundle photo accurate?
faq.a: Upload or describe every included item and state the exact count. Review the output against the real bundle before listing it; the tool can add or omit pieces.

overview.h2: Answer the Bundle Question in One Frame
overview.p: A bundle image is useful when the shopper can count the pieces without opening a dropdown or reading a long description. Lay out the products, packaging, and any included accessory as one clear group, while keeping decorative props quiet and separate.

overview.h2: Treat the Contents List as the Source of Truth
overview.p: The picture helps people understand the set at a glance; your written contents list still defines what ships. Build the source around the exact inventory so a refill pouch, spare lid, or gift box does not disappear from the composition.

input_guide.h2: Gather the Set Before You Write the Scene

items.d: Place the main item, refills, tools, inserts, and box together before taking the source photo.
If flowers, towels, ribbons, or food are only styling, keep them visibly outside the bundle group.
Include the carton, sleeve, pouch, or branded box when it is part of what the customer receives.
Name the count and placement, such as one bottle, one refill, one scoop, and one box on a stone tray.
Give the shopper a visual inventory before they compare price or size.
Show which refill, accessory, or smaller item belongs with the main product.
Use the box, sleeve, ribbon, or tray to set expectations for a ready-to-give set.
Use the downloaded frame in a product gallery, feed post, or bundle announcement after checking it.
Cleanser, serum, cream jar, and printed carton on a round stone tray with no extra bottles.
Coffee pouch, scoop, mug, and brewing guide on a kitchen counter, with the plant kept as a background accent.
Case, screen protector, cleaning cloth, and alignment tool in one ordered row beside the box.
Two candles, match tin, and gift sleeve on a wood table with one small seasonal branch outside the group.

after_download.h2: Reconcile the Image With the Offer

items.d: Check lids, refills, tools, and packaging against the actual kit before publishing.
Write the precise contents, quantity, and size in your product title or description.
Crop or replace any frame where a prop could be mistaken for a shipped item.

fit.h2: Good Fits for a Bundle Frame
good: Fixed gift sets and starter kits
Refill packs with a main product
Subscription boxes with a stable contents list
Accessories sold together as one SKU
not_ideal: Mystery boxes whose contents change per order
Bundles where every piece needs its own instructional view
Products with a dense written specification that cannot be shown visually

examples.lead: Show every item that ships in the set, and keep props clearly apart from what the buyer receives.
